difficulty_reason: Prove the diagonal of Quot_{F/X/B} is a closed immersion, of finite presentation when F is of finite type: for two T-points F_T -> Q_1, Q_2 form K_1 = ker(Q_1) and u: K_1 -> Q_2; the F-zero-closed lemma gives a closed subspace of T consisting exactly of the points where u_{T'} = 0, which is the base change of the diagonal; finite-typedness of K_1 (kernel of a surjection onto a finitely presented module) upgrades the closed immersion to finite presentation by the same lemma.
